SPECIFICATION FOR (Reaffirmed 2017) 

OSTEOTOMES. STILLE PATTERN, ORTHOPAEDIC 


1. Scope — Dimensions and requirements for Stllle pattern osteotomes used in orthopaedic surgery. 

2. Material — Stainless steel conforming to Designation 30013 of Schedule V of IS : IS70-1961* or 
stainless steel of the following composition: 


Carbon 

Silicon 

Manganese 

Chromium 

Nickel 

Sulphur 

Phosphorus 

3. Shape and Dimensions — As shown in Fig. 1.

FIG 1 OSTEOTOME, STILLE PATTERN 


4. Requirements 

4.1 Workmanship — All the surfaces of osteotomes shall be free from pits, burrs, cracks, and other surface 
defects. The cutting edge of the instrument shall be properly sharpened and shall be free from burrs, 
feathers, nicks and wavlness. All the other edges shall be even. 

4.2 Finish —The Instrument shall be suitably passivated and finished smooth and bright.

m m 





IS : 5583 - 1970 

4.3 Hurclness —Evenly hardened and tempered to 500 to 550 HV. 

4 A Performance— The osteotomes held firmly and vertically with the cutting edge downward on a piece of 
hard and dry sheep bone shall be given 20 full blows on the head with a 500-g hammer. On completion 
of test, head shall not become mushroom shaped. The cutting edge shall not show any sign of damage or 
loss of cutting efficiency and the shank shall not show any deformation. 

4.5 Coirosion Resistance ( Copper Sulphate Test) — Scrub the sample with soap and warm water, rinse in 
hot water, and then dip In 95 percent ethyl alcohol. Dry the sample. Immerse in copper sulphate solution 
at room temperature for 6 minutes and wash off with fresh water or wet cotton wool. Make up the 
solution IS follows: 

Copper sulphate ( CuS0 4 .5H 2 0 ) 4.0 g 

Sulphuric add ( H 2 S0 4 ) ( sp gr 1.84 ) 10.0 g 

Water (H 2 0) 90.0 ml 

No red stains or spots on the sample shall be allowed but dulling of the polished surface may be 
permitted. 

5. Marking — Shall be legibly and Indelibly marked with the manufacturer’s name or Initials or recognized 
trade-mark. 

5.1 ISI Certifiction Marking — Details available from the Indian Standards Institution. 

6. Packing— Shall be as agreed to between the purchaser and the supplier.
